description: Ninety minutes of KR4OGH PT-01 on 20 m channel 206 (2026-10-24 16:00-17:30 UTC), the first flight of the Petrel tracker, ingested from wspr.live with every column. The tracker sends its BME280 reading as extended telemetry in slot 3 (six minutes after the Regular message). Expected output cross-checked against an independent decoder written from the Petrel notes; the known-good bench message 100ECD HP29 43 decodes to 27 C / 1016 hPa / 19 % in both. The nine fixes climb from 2,800 m to 6,800 m and the pressure falls 709 to 415 hPa.
